description: This file defines the Statistics model class for the report module in an OpenCart admin project. It includes methods for retrieving and modifying statistic data stored in the database, adhering to the application's architecture for models.

classes.name: Statistics
classes.description: A model class responsible for accessing and manipulating statistical data in the database, including retrieving, adding, removing, and editing statistic values.

methods.name: getStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves all statistic records from the database table 'statistics'.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Fetches the value associated with a specific statistic code.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Increases the value of a specified statistic by a given amount.

methods.name: removeValue
methods.description: Decreases the value of a specific statistic by a given amount.

methods.name: editValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a specific statistic to a new value.
